create.name: Jason McGrice
create.bio:
Jason McGrice is an Australian meditation teacher, Reiki master and mentor based in Adelaide. Drawn to spiritual practice from childhood, he took up meditation seriously in his early twenties and has worked with Reiki for more than twenty years, alongside training as a Spinal Energetics practitioner. His teaching centres on simple, effortless meditation and on energy work, offered with a warm, down-to-earth manner that makes the practices feel approachable for people who think meditation is not for them.

He is best known for his guided meditations and courses on Insight Timer, where his recordings have been played millions of times by a large community of students. Online, he teaches a three-day introduction to meditation over Zoom in the effortless 'being' technique of the 1 Giant Mind school, built around three ninety-minute sessions that lay the ground for a daily practice. He also mentors individuals one to one over a month, three months or a year, combining meditation, energy practice and mindful living, and has led residential Reiki Master retreats in South Australia. As a speaker and facilitator he runs group and mass meditation sessions and talks about resilience and finding meaning in everyday life.

courses.title: Learn to Meditate
courses.description: A three-day beginners' course on Zoom, with a ninety-minute session each day. Jason teaches the effortless 'being' technique from 1 Giant Mind and shows how to carry it into a daily practice after the course ends.

courses.title: 1:1 Mentoring
courses.description: Private mentoring with Jason over one, three or twelve months, with regular sessions and message support in between. The work combines meditation, energy practice and practical steps towards your aims.

free_resources.title: Jason McGrice on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His Insight Timer profile, with a large library of guided meditations and courses. The tracks are free to play.
